Questions before you set off?

Before you wander.

What do you do in CASCADE?

Reorder one row of shapes or words, carry it down through the platforms, and deliver the exact target. Every exchange matters because a platform has limited durability.

Is this a matching game?

No. The same row stays with you. You decide which exchanges to make now, what to leave for the next platform, and when to descend.

Can I play with shapes instead of words?

Yes. Shapes, Words and Mixed have their own journeys. Interface and puzzle languages can be chosen separately. English, Russian and Ukrainian are supported.

How do tools and platform effects help?

Some floors change the row on landing. A key opens a connection, repair adds durability, and frost delays a bomb. Their timing matters as much as the order of your pieces.

Do I need an account?

Core play saves locally. Optional Apple or Google sign-in is being prepared for cloud progress and eligible purchases. Until a released version confirms a successful sync, do not rely on a cloud backup.

How do I restore a purchase?

Use Settings → Restore purchases with the same store account. Eligible non-consumable purchases can be restored after verification. Already spent coins are not reissued. See Support for the difference between store restoration and cloud progress.

Can I turn off movement and reminders?

Yes. The game has reduced-motion and reminder settings, plus notification controls on your device. This website has its own Pause motion button and respects your system’s reduced-motion preference.
